explanation_full: The GRA analysis clearly establishes VFA as the most influential feature (score: 0.7931), followed by Butyrate (0.7902) and Acetate (0.7772). Regarding model performance, KNN is the superior model, achieving an R² of 0.81717. The incremental feature analysis supports the importance of feature count, showing that the KNN score peaked at 0.830140 when 9 features were used. These findings suggest that VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate are key predictors, and the model benefits from a moderate number of features.
